# m.economy.funding_conditions

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

US short-term funding conditions: policy, overnight, and repo rates, one row per day.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.economy.funding_conditions(*, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Date`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first date. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last date. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any of Massive's field names, such as `"effective_fed_funds_rate"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters. Keys: none. |
| [`on_error`](README.md#on_error) | What a bad symbol or row does in this call (`dm.ErrorPolicy`). None, the default, takes each cause from the session's `MassiveConfig.on_error`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Funding Conditions (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| All Stocks plans | Updated daily, All history |
| All Options plans | Updated daily, All history |
| All Indices plans | Updated daily, All history |
| All Currencies plans | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Date` | String | Calendar date of the observation (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `EffectiveFedFundsRate` | double | Federal Funds Effective Rate as a percentage (DFF series from FRED); published daily. |
| `EffectiveFedFundsVolume` | double | Total transaction volume underlying the effective federal funds rate calculation, in billions of U.S. dollars; reported on business days. |
| `FedFundsTargetLower` | double | Lower bound of the federal funds target range as a percentage (DFEDTARL series from FRED); posted every calendar day. |
| `FedFundsTargetUpper` | double | Upper bound of the federal funds target range as a percentage (DFEDTARU series from FRED); posted every calendar day. |
| `FedOvernightRepoTreasuryAmount` | double | NY Fed overnight repo operation amount against Treasury collateral, in billions of U.S. dollars (RPONTSYD series from FRED); reported on business days. |
| `FedOvernightReverseRepoTreasuryAmount` | double | NY Fed overnight reverse repo operation amount against Treasury collateral, in billions of U.S. dollars (RRPONTSYD series from FRED); reported on business days. |
| `FinancialCommercialPaper90dRate` | double | 90-day AA financial commercial paper interest rate as a percentage, quoted on a discount basis (DCPF3M series from FRED); reported on business days, with occasional source-level gaps. |
| `InterestOnReserveBalances` | double | Interest rate paid on reserve balances as a percentage (IORB series from FRED); posted every calendar day. |
| `NonfinancialCommercialPaper90dRate` | double | 90-day AA nonfinancial commercial paper interest rate as a percentage, quoted on a discount basis (DCPN3M series from FRED); reported on business days, with occasional source-level gaps. |
| `Obfr25thPercentile` | double | 25th percentile transaction rate of the OBFR distribution as a percentage; posted on business days. |
| `Obfr75thPercentile` | double | 75th percentile transaction rate of the OBFR distribution as a percentage; posted on business days. |
| `ObfrVolume` | double | Total transaction volume underlying the OBFR calculation, in billions of U.S. dollars; reported on business days. |
| `OvernightBankFundingRate` | double | Overnight Bank Funding Rate (OBFR) as a percentage; published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and reported on business days. |
| `SecuredOvernightFinancingRate` | double | Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) as a percentage; published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and reported on business days. |
| `Sofr25thPercentile` | double | 25th percentile transaction rate of the SOFR distribution as a percentage; posted on business days. |
| `Sofr75thPercentile` | double | 75th percentile transaction rate of the SOFR distribution as a percentage; posted on business days. |
| `SofrVolume` | double | Total transaction volume underlying the SOFR calculation, in billions of U.S. dollars; reported on business days. |
| `Tgcr25thPercentile` | double | 25th percentile transaction rate of the TGCR distribution as a percentage; posted on business days. |
| `Tgcr75thPercentile` | double | 75th percentile transaction rate of the TGCR distribution as a percentage; posted on business days. |
| `TriPartyGeneralCollateralRate` | double | Tri-Party General Collateral Rate (TGCR) as a percentage; published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York as a repo reference rate and reported on business days. |
| `TriPartyGeneralCollateralVolume` | double | Total transaction volume underlying the TGCR calculation, in billions of U.S. dollars; reported on business days. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
